BL-1801 — A local-model seat never launches past the window Ollama serves it: after Ollama is ready and before any pane starts, the launch estimates each local-model seat's first turn (composed prompt plus the qwen CLI's recorded overhead, 3 characters a token) against the num_ctx Ollama reports for the seat's model, or the context length the swarm started it with; it refuses when the known window cannot hold the first turn, warns when the first turn takes more than half the window or the window is unknown, and SWARMFORGE_LOCAL_WINDOW_OVERRIDE=1 turns a refusal into a warning
What it solves: ## Human ruling (2026-09-29, in the specifier's chat, verbatim)
Approval context: A new feature file needs a tap. The design was ruled in chat on 2026-09-29 (quoted in source), so no choice is posed. FIRM - the window source is the running Ollama (/api/show num_ctx, else the context length the swarm started it with, else unknown). Known and cannot hold the first turn: refuse bef…
BL-1801 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1801" (or "reject BL-1801 <reason>") to act.
